# NovaMac Solutions — High-Performance Software & Digital Studio
> NovaMac Solutions builds custom Next.js web applications, UI/UX design systems, AI CRMs, and headless e-commerce platforms.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Custom Web Development](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/custom-web-development): High-speed Next.js platforms built from scratch with 100% source code ownership. (Starting from $499)
- [Custom E-Commerce](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/ecommerce-development): Headless storefronts, Shopify Storefront API, and WooCommerce custom builds. (Starting from $799)
- [AI Automation & Autonomous Agents](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/ai-automation): Custom LLM integrations, RAG systems, and AI customer agents. (Starting from $499)
- [CRM & Business Automation](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/crm-custom-software): Bespoke internal platforms replacing spreadsheets with automated lead pipelines. (Starting from $599)
- [Graphic Design & Brand Identity](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/graphic-design-branding): High-impact vector logos, brand guidelines, and visual identity packs. (Starting from $149)
- [B2B Lead Generation & Sales Funnels](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/lead-generation-funnels): Automated lead capture engines, cold outreach, and landing pages. (Starting from $249/mo)
- [Mobile App Development](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android applications with native performance. (Starting from $899)
- [Performance Marketing & SEO](https://novamacsolutions.com/services/performance-marketing-seo): Data-driven technical SEO, paid acquisition, and conversion optimization. (Starting from $199/mo)
